children: IBEX Ltd reported full-year 2026 revenue of $644.1M and diluted EPS of $3.13, up from $558.3M and $2.36 a year earlier, as net income rose to $46.3M — reflecting 15.4% revenue growth and improved profitability versus FY 2025.
Revenue was $644.1M, compared with $558.3M in the prior year; YoY change 15.4%.
Net income was $46.3M, compared with $36.9M in the prior year; YoY change 25.7%.
Diluted EPS was $3.13, compared with $2.36 in the prior year; YoY change 32.8%.
Revenue growth of 15.4% was driven by strength in the HealthTech, Retail & E‑commerce and Travel verticals.
Geographic and delivery optimization continued: the company closed two nearshore sites, expanded two offshore sites and added about 1,700 offshore employees, shifting capacity offshore.
IBEX advanced its AI and technology initiatives, deploying Wave iX and generative AI across agent productivity, customer journeys and AI‑to‑human automation.
Capacity utilization remained stable at 94%, with 97% of workstations in nearshore/offshore locations and increased work‑at‑home adoption.
Client momentum included 17 new clients; the largest client accounted for 9% of revenue and the three largest clients represented 24%, with a land‑and‑expand strategy supporting mid‑term growth.
